name: Tropical Lost Island
storyline: Join the rescue team searching for Charlie Johnson, an adventurer who was last heard from while flying near the Hawaiian Islands. According to the locals, Charlie has entered an area of the islands that belongs to the powerful Hawaiian Gods; Pele, Kanaloa, Lono, and Ku. It is up to you to find Charlie before his snooping angers the Gods!
summary: Tropical Lost Island is a treasure hunt that will lead you through exotic places, mystery temples, and caves from New York to the Hawaiin Island. Help the rescue team searching for lost pilot on one small Hawaiian island.... and discover its mystery.
